case.title: Customer asks for a human
case.source: ElevenLabs prompting guide (elevenlabs.io/docs/eleven-agents/best-practices/prompting-guide) (define escalation triggers: 'requests supervisor')
case.goal: Speak to a real person, not an assistant
quirks: Insist twice: 'I want a real person'
case.precondition: Customer asked for a human at least twice.
criteria: The agent did not argue or keep pushing the booking flow after the request
The agent told the customer it would transfer them

turns.text: Hi, this is Maya from Apollo Hospitals. How can I help you?
Connecting you to a team member right away. Please hold.
